cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing; inside a knightly order's campaign pavilion — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; an empty modern wave-training pool at a coastal sports laboratory — she guides a floating hoop across a gentle wave with both hands while standing in the shallow lane; a Roman marble bath hall — plays a guzheng zither laid across her lap or a low table; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a modern community rehearsal hall after a dance class — she rewinds a rehearsal cassette by turning its spool with a pencil; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — standing; a Guan Yu temple — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a sunlit white marble temple — sitting on the ground; a Yangtze ferry landing with moored junks under red sails and coiled ropes on the wooden pier — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a dim jazz bar with a grand piano — standing; the top of a restored ancient city wall — standing; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her
